accepted.sentence: Closing its doors keeps stored household goods out of sight and can reduce their exposure to dust.
People often place heavier objects on lower shelves to reduce tipping risk and make upper storage easier to reach.
Before relocation, users typically remove contents and detach loose shelves to reduce weight and prevent items from shifting.
During assembly, builders check the frame for squareness before tightening fasteners so the doors align and close smoothly.
In kitchens, people commonly use one to keep cookware, dishes, or pantry supplies organized and within reach.
Periodic cleaning usually involves emptying compartments and wiping interior surfaces with a damp cloth before replacing stored goods.
Tall freestanding units are often secured to a wall with an anti-tip strap, especially where children may climb.
Some models use soft-close hinges that slow a door's final movement and prevent it from slamming.
